title: AI Ad Managers Are Here. But Can They Really Do Your Job? - Sumu Akter

facts.fact: The author reports that clients using Meta Advantage+ have seen lower cost-per-acquisition, up to 20–30% better, especially when using a mix of creatives.

facts.fact: The author states that Google launched AI Max in 2025 as a more advanced version of Performance Max.
facts.quote: In 2025, Google launched **AI Max**, a smarter, more advanced version of Performance Max.

facts.fact: The article was published on July 20, 2025.
According to the author, Google AI Max runs ads across Google Search, YouTube, Gmail, Maps, and the Display Network within one campaign.
facts.quote: AI Max runs your ads across Google Search, YouTube, Gmail, Maps, and the Display Network—all in one campaign.
